evidence: packages/builder-workspace/server/session_manager.py returns PIL_UNAVAILABLE when PILPipeline is not importable
docs/production_path_rules.json has no allowed findings for _MockAdapter or SimplePipeline in production Builder code
entries.notes: Task 19 removed the production SimplePipeline fallback and _MockAdapter. Production prompt paths must fail visibly or use a real configured provider/PIL path. Mock adapter behavior may remain only in isolated tests.

entries.title: Optional or skipped SGC execution paths
evidence: packages/builder-workspace/server/session_manager.py:487 returns SGCCompileResult(status=skipped) when no SGC binary is configured
packages/builder-workspace/server/session_manager.py:498 returns SGCCompileResult(status=skipped) when no systems are present
packages/builder-workspace/server/ws_message_router.py rejects structural prompt applies when SGC returns an explicit skipped/unsupported result
packages/builder-workspace/server/builder_server.py documents that structural prompt applies block when --sgc-bin is omitted
entries.notes: Task 17 blocks structural Builder applies when SGC proof is unavailable. Task 18 requires the certification prompt proof to invoke the real SGC binary. Later SGC authority tasks decide which skipped statuses remain legal for non-mutating/headless/no-system cases.

entries.title: Certification skip modes and installed-engine omissions
evidence: tools/certify_launch.py writes launch_certification_report.json for pass and fail runs

tools/certify_launch.py writes installed_engine_summary.json with unsupported Godot/Unity/Unreal entries when --installed-engines is not run
entries.notes: Quick/editor-free certification is useful but must never imply installed Godot/Unity/Unreal proof. Task 12 now emits explicit artifacts; later installed-engine tasks must replace unsupported entries with real editor proof.

entries.title: Smoke-only and proof-only tools
evidence: tools/sgc_cli_smoke.py:5 says it tests the CLI, not fake wiring

tools/provider_readiness_smoke.py uses isolated fake key material
entries.notes: These tools can be launch evidence only for the scenarios they execute. They are not broad production guarantees.
